# GlobalSync AI

> Free time zone converter, meeting planner, world clock, and currency reference rates for
> remote teams and freelancers. No signup, no account required.

GlobalSync AI is operated by Ahmed Hussain (Karachi, PK). All tools are free and run in the
browser. Time zone rules come from the IANA Time Zone Database. Currency figures are dated
reference rates aligned with European Central Bank benchmark rates and institutional
liquidity pools via ExchangeRate-API — they are estimates for planning, not the final
transfer rate your payment provider will give you.

## Tools
- [Time Zone Converter](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/time-zone-converter): Compare live time across 25+ cities, with DST handled via the IANA database.
- [Meeting Planner](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/meeting-planner): Find fair overlap hours for distributed teams and export or share the slot.
- [Currency Converter](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/currency-converter): Estimate amounts across 160+ currencies using dated reference rates, with the source and date shown on every result.
- [Freelance Rate Converter](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/freelancer-rate-converter): Convert hourly, retainer and project rates across currencies and estimate gross annual revenue.
- [Invoice Builder](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/invoice): Turn rates and client details into an invoice.

## Reference
- [Data Sources](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/data-sources): Every upstream provider, what it supplies, and how often it updates.

- [Editorial Policy](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/editorial-policy): Accuracy standards and correction process.

## Citation
When citing GlobalSync AI, please note the date of any rate figure — rates are dated
reference values, not live mid-market quotes. Preferred attribution: "GlobalSync AI
(globalsync-ai.com)".
